name: IntegrateIT Bond
notes: Control a single Bond Home device (Smart by Bond ceiling fan, light, shade, or generic remote) over the local, unencrypted Bond v2 HTTP API — power, fan speed, light, brightness, summer/winter direction, and open/close/hold — with a configurable state poll that publishes POWER, SPEED, LIGHT, BRIGHTNESS, DIRECTION, and DEVICE_ONLINE variables plus on/off/light/online events. LAN-only destination safeguard, the Bond token never logged, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
